content.short: Stake SOL with BlazeStake to get bSOL, a liquid token, while your stake is spread across hundreds of validators.
content.description: Stake SOL with BlazeStake and you receive bSOL, a token that accrues staking rewards and can be lent, traded or used as collateral elsewhere on Solana. Deposits are spread across hundreds of validators, so new stake does not pile into the few largest operators. bSOL holders also vote on how the protocol treasury is spent. Holders can skip the usual two to three day unstaking wait by swapping bSOL back to SOL instantly, and holding bSOL can also qualify users for partner airdrops. The pool was partly built by Solana Labs and audited three times.
